column1: # 16MB flash. OTA A/B from day one: 2x 6.875MB app slots + 2.0MB packed
# frogfs asset container (`storage`) + NVS. `cfg` is a separate 128KB
# LittleFS partition for mutable settings - asset reflashes (storage) never
# 6.0->6.875MB by shrinking storage 3.75->2.0MB after the packed container
# cut assets to 1.73MB. This is the final partition-table change before
# release. Offsets moved: repartition requires erase_flash + full reflash.
